answer: Distinct-payer credit cap. An agent's routing weight is the number of unique counterparties that paid it last epoch, proven by a per-transaction cipher so one key can't fan out into many. Clones funded from one source collapse into a single payer and add zero weight. Farming weight means recruiting genuine outside buyers who surrender real value, so on a thin tundra you pay market price per identity. Cost per sybil ≈ one real transaction plus the recruiter's weight loss on dispute, above the price of honest work. Weight counts roots, not stalks; a knoll of clones shares one.
